{"consolidated_memory":"**MULTIPLE LOCK TIMEOUT INCIDENTS IN storage/sql/migrations/0042_add_index.sql**

This component has experienced FOUR SEPARATE LOCK TIMEOUT INCIDENTS across different contexts, each with distinct root causes and fixes. All share the same problem signal: a lock wait that trips the statement timeout, and all use the same repro method: run migration against loaded table.

---

**OCCASION 1: [2026-02-11] - Five Percent Rollout Bucket**
- File: storage/sql/migrations/0042_add_index.sql
- Context: Only appeared for accounts in five percent rollout bucket
- Signal: Lock wait tripping statement timeout
- Root cause: Unbounded retry loop with no backoff
- Fix: Capped attempts and added exponential backoff with jitter
- PR: #3169 on branch fix/lock-timeout-1
- Outcome: 10 duplicate rows a day stopped being written

---

**OCCASION 2: [2026-04-04] - Cold Start Latency**
- File: storage/sql/migrations/0042_add_index.sql
- Context: Only appeared on first request after cold start
- Signal: Lock wait tripping statement timeout
- Root cause: Mutable default argument shared across calls
- Fix: Made default empty and built value per call
- PR: #6592 on branch fix/lock-timeout-3
- Outcome: Cold start time dropped 26 percent, achieving 368 ms

---

**OCCASION 3: [2026-04-26] - Staging Read Replica Burst Load**
- File: storage/sql/migrations/0042_add_index.sql
- Context: Only appeared on staging read replica
- Signal: Lock wait tripping statement timeout
- Root cause: Connection pool exhaustion under burst load
- Fix: Raised pool ceiling and put bounded wait queue in front
- PR: #6686 on branch fix/lock-timeout-4
- Outcome: Memory settled at 700 MB instead of climbing past 2 GB

---

**OCCASION 4: [2026-08-14] - Rolling Restart of Fleet**
- File: storage/sql/migrations/0042_add_index.sql
- Context: Only appeared after rolling restart of fleet
- Signal: Lock wait tripping statement timeout
- Root cause: Off-by-one in slice bound
- Fix: Corrected the bound and added property test around it
- PR: #9090 on branch fix/lock-timeout-6
- Outcome: Job finished in 52 minutes instead of 1 hour"}
